name: Lo-fi Hip-Hop Loop
description:
# Lo-fi Hip-Hop Loop

Four-bar lo-fi hip-hop instrumental at 80 BPM in F minor. Stereo 44.1kHz / 16-bit WAV, ~12 seconds. Layers: vinyl-textured boom-bap drums (kick + dusty snare + hi-hats), warm Rhodes chord progression (Fm7 - Bbm7 - Eb7 - Abmaj7), filtered sub bass, and a soft sidechain pad. Suitable as a backing reference for any lo-fi composition skill.
applicability: Lo-fi hip-hop instrumental loop reference with classic boom-bap drums and jazz-influenced Rhodes chords.

name: Drum Breakbeat Pattern
description:
# Drum Breakbeat Pattern

Two-bar MIDI breakbeat pattern in 4/4 at 90 BPM, single track. Pattern: classic Amen-style break — kick on beats 1+3, snare on 2+4 with ghost notes, syncopated hi-hat 16ths, and crash on the downbeat of bar 2. Pitched on GM drum channel (channel 10, MIDI key 36 = kick, 38 = snare, 42 = closed hat, 49 = crash).
applicability: Reusable breakbeat MIDI pattern as a rhythmic foundation for hip-hop, drum-and-bass, or jungle compositions.

name: Synth Pad Chord Bed
description:
# Synth Pad Chord Bed

Eight-bar warm synth pad bed in C major, stereo 44.1kHz / 24-bit WAV, ~16 seconds. Slow attack, gentle filter sweep, subtle stereo width via chorus. Chord progression: I - vi - IV - V (C - Am - F - G). Suitable as a foundation layer for ambient, cinematic, or pop arrangement skills.
applicability: Warm synth pad chord bed as a foundation layer for ambient, cinematic, or pop arrangements.
